hypotheses.justification: This instance is automatically included but unnecessary. The definition nGL is AutomorphicForm.unipotentGL2, whose matrix value is definitionally !![1, x; 0, 1] over any commutative ring. The tensor-product ring structure requires no NumberField L instance. Thus omitting [NumberField L] leaves the statement well-formed and the proof remains rfl, for every x, including zero.
